caption: A purple bath bomb is dropped into a tub of clear water, and the colour billows out and turns the whole bath purple.

sa.check: A tub of clear water is present.
A purple bath bomb is dropped in.
The bath bomb fizzes as the colour spreads.

pc.expect: The purple spreads from the bath bomb through the water as it fizzes, thinning as it goes, until the water is evenly coloured and never gathers back; coloured areas stay coloured.
pc.fail: The water returns to its original colour where it was purple; or the purple gathers back into the bath bomb; or the purple appears before the bath bomb arrives.

pc.expect: The result is purple, and un-reached water keeps its original colour.
pc.fail: The water turns a colour other than purple; or the un-reached water changes; or the purple is darker than the bath bomb itself.

pc.expect: The water behaves as it should: streaks and swirls where stirred or spread, settling where it flows.
pc.fail: The water is rigid and unmarked; or it flows like water when it is a paste; or it bounces like rubber.

pc.expect: The water moves only where stirred or where the purple flows.
pc.fail: The water swirls by itself; or the purple spreads faster than stirring or flow carries it; or the container moves.

pc.expect: The amount of water stays the same and the container keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The container fills or empties on its own; or a second container appears; or the bath bomb passes through the container.

pc.expect: The container and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The container changes colour; or the background rearranges; or the tool changes.
